description_en: Retrieves a list of tags by ResourceId or Tag (by key only, or by both key and value)
description_zh: 通过ResourceId或者Tag（Key查询、key和value同时查询）获取标签列表
kebab_example: aliyun cassandra list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token NextToken --resource-id example-string --tag Value=value1 Key=key1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. If the response contains a large amount of data, a NextToken is returned
parameters.help_zh: 如果数据过多，会返回NextToken，用于查询下一页
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of resource N. In this context, the resource ID is the cluster ID. You can query multiple resources at a time by specifying ResourceId.2, ResourceId.3, and so on. N is a positive integer
parameters.help_zh: 第N个资源Id，此处是为集群Id。可同时查询多个资源，可以传参数名为ResourceId.2、ResourceId.3等等。N为正整数
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The key of the tag to query. You can specify multiple keys. N is a positive integer
fields.help_zh: 要查询的标签的key，可有多个。N为正整数
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag to query. You can specify multiple values. N is a positive integer
fields.help_zh: 要查询的标签的value，可有多个。N为正整数
fields.name: value
